author: 5kO0
content:
Implemented (this session). Added string_format_to_rust(format: Option<&str>) -> &'static str helper in proto-blue-codegen/src/generator.rs and wired type_to_rust through it.

Lexicon format → Rust mapping landed:
  did            → proto_blue_syntax::Did
  handle         → proto_blue_syntax::Handle
  at-identifier  → proto_blue_syntax::AtIdentifier
  nsid           → proto_blue_syntax::Nsid
  at-uri         → proto_blue_syntax::AtUri
  tid            → proto_blue_syntax::Tid
  record-key     → proto_blue_syntax::RecordKey
  datetime       → proto_blue_syntax::Datetime
  cid / language / uri / no format / unknown → String (see fn doc for why)

Why language and uri keep String: their newtypes in proto_blue_syntax don't currently impl serde Serialize/Deserialize, so emitting them in derive(Serialize, Deserialize) structs wouldn't compile. Promote in a follow-up once those traits land. Why cid keeps String: format: cid on plain string is rare and semantically distinct from cid-link (which is already correctly typed via LexUserType::CidLink → Cid).

Severity reassessment (rust-fix-discipline §1.6): I initially extended the same mapping to param_type_to_rust for symmetry. That broke 224 sites in the codegen-emitted to_query_params / params_from_ctx helpers, which are templated for String fields (.clone(), String::from). Param promotion needs separate codegen-plumbing changes; spun out as #21 (subissue under #1). #3's actual scope is type_to_rust per the audit's smoking-gun reference (generator.rs:957).

Files changed:
  proto-blue-codegen/src/generator.rs                 — string_format_to_rust + type_to_rust wired through it
  proto-blue-api/src/generated/**                     — 193 files regenerated (508/508 line diff: pure type swaps after rustfmt)
  proto-blue-api/tests/generated_register.rs          — 1 test updated to construct Did::new / Handle::new

API surface impact (BREAKING for downstream consumers):
  Every generated record / output struct field that previously was `String` and whose lexicon declares format: did|handle|at-identifier|nsid|at-uri|tid|record-key|datetime is now the corresponding proto_blue_syntax newtype.
  Migration: replace `"did:plc:foo".to_string()` with `Did::new("did:plc:foo")?`, replace `&owned_string` parameters with `&did.to_string()` if calling functions that still take String, etc.

Verification (rust-quality §honest reporting):
  cargo build --workspace                                  PASS
  cargo test --workspace                                   PASS (67 test suites, 0 failures)
  cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings    PASS
  cargo fmt --all --check                                  PASS

Behavioural change: yes, public-API breaking on the `proto-blue-api` crate. Wire format unchanged (newtypes serde-(de)serialize to/from the same string bytes as before).

Category: A (root-cause) — added the missing format dispatch, regenerated the entire affected surface in one bump.

Related: #21 (XRPC param newtypes — follow-up); #4 + #5 (audit recommended bundling but landed #3 alone per scope).
